count_definitions.ready: A crosswalk row resolves to scope, journey or approved exclusion, fixture/precondition, authority, environment, and retained evidence without a row-level blocker.
count_definitions.blocked: The item is present and mapped, but one or more explicit blocker IDs prevent coding-ready atomic parity input.
count_definitions.excluded: The item is present only as an approved external, platform, branding, or scope boundary.
count_definitions.crosswalk_complete: Every source item is represented exactly once and every non-ready item has an explicit blocker or exclusion; it does not mean discovery is coding-ready.

reconciled_source_repairs: Canonicalized the preliminary LOOKUP-STROKE-ORDER-OVERLAY identifier to the recursive-crawl ID LOOKUP-KANJI-STROKE-ORDER across the surface map, journey, transition table, and reachability map.
Recomputed surface-map scope counts after Image Text scope decisions and discovery of Kanji Etymology: 15 blocking, 1 navigation-support, 7 excluded, 23 total.
Added the recursively discovered LOOKUP-KANJI-ETYMOLOGY surface to the approved Inspect Kanji journey and Kanji Detail outgoing graph.

conflicts.summary: Vertical OCR token grouping crossed authored columns: selecting 読 yielded 読本.
A visible speaker control does not distinguish a human recording from speech synthesis or prove audible output.
Public OCR provider and offline-mode disclosures do not identify the provider or network path used by the captured Image Text fixtures.
The visible pitch contour proves presentation but not CJKI record matching, transformation, or fallback.

crosswalk_gaps.missing: Quantified color, typography, spacing, geometry, and icon metrics are not present in the retained crawl.
crosswalk_gaps.completed_independent_work: Every retained state screenshot is hash-indexed and mapped to token roles.
crosswalk_gaps.resume_procedure: Measure the pinned screenshots or repeat privacy-safe capture with calibrated pixel/semantic geometry; append measurements without changing the observed baseline.

crosswalk_gaps.missing: Exact visible glyph identities, vector bounds, and licensing are not established.
crosswalk_gaps.completed_independent_work: Visible icon roles are mapped to surfaces and evidence; Zenbu branding is an approved variance.
crosswalk_gaps.resume_procedure: Inventory each glyph role from the pinned screenshots, select original or licensed Zenbu assets, and record prohibited exact-parity claims.

inherited_access_blockers.field: exact device locale
inherited_access_blockers.completed_independent_work: The app visibly rendered English copy in the pinned runtime; alternate locales are outside the approved dossier scope.
inherited_access_blockers.fallback: Treat the observed English app UI as the runtime language authority without asserting a device locale.
resume_procedure: The device owner opens Settings → General → Language & Region on the physical iPhone.
The owner reports only the Language and Region values, or approves a tightly cropped screenshot containing only those values.
The discovery driver updates the authority and environment cell without retaining Apple ID, location, preferred-language history, or other settings.

inherited_access_blockers.field: Nihongo account/purchase entitlement state
affected_records: future Search rows whose behavior differs by entitlement
inherited_access_blockers.completed_independent_work: No in-app account, sign-in state, trial banner, paywall, or entitlement badge was visible on the empty Search root. The installed app identity and build are pinned.
inherited_access_blockers.fallback: Describe only the observed installed runtime and do not call it paid, Pro, trial, subscribed, or account-bound.
resume_procedure: The device owner states whether this installation is paid/Pro, trial, free, or otherwise entitled without disclosing an Apple ID or receipt.
During Search reconnaissance, record any limit, paywall, restore-purchase control, or entitlement-dependent Search behavior if it becomes reachable.
Update the authority and every affected journey row with the confirmed state and evidence source.
blocks_final_rows: Any later row claiming paid/Pro-only Search behavior

inherited_access_blockers.field: camera, Photos, Files, and clipboard permission/access states
affected_records: future image and input journey rows
inherited_access_blockers.completed_independent_work: Files single and multiple selection were observed with isolated synthetic fixtures. The private-access Photo picker opened and was cancelled without selection or retained evidence. The stakeholder then waived Camera and Photo Library source mechanics for this discovery outcome.
inherited_access_blockers.fallback: Keep future clipboard-input permission claims unknown; Camera and Photos rows are excluded under the recorded stakeholder scope decision.
resume_procedure: For any future clipboard-input claim, replace the Mac clipboard with a known synthetic value before focusing Search.
Record whether iOS prompts, allows, denies, or transfers that exact synthetic value.
Restore the starting clipboard state if it can be done without reading or retaining private content.

inherited_access_blockers.field: device-local Copy Text payload from an Image Text result
inherited_access_blockers.owner: discovery driver with a device-local paste target or semantic clipboard authority
inherited_access_blockers.completed_independent_work: Copy Text was selected on a purpose-created result and visibly dismissed its menu. Reading the Mac clipboard returned a pre-existing Mac value, so Universal Clipboard cannot be used as evidence of Nihongo's copied payload.
inherited_access_blockers.fallback: Use visible recognition overlays and token selection as parsing evidence; do not claim the exact Copy Text serialization.
resume_procedure: Open IMG-FIXTURE-001 through Files and select Copy Text.
Paste into an isolated, empty, device-local text destination without invoking the Mac Universal Clipboard.
Capture and compare exact text, order, whitespace, punctuation, omitted non-Japanese content, and multi-image behavior, then delete the synthetic paste.
blocks_final_rows: Exact Image Text Copy Text serialization

inherited_access_blockers.field: content-size category
inherited_access_blockers.completed_independent_work: The exact screen geometry and 3× display scale are pinned in the baseline evidence.
inherited_access_blockers.fallback: Describe geometry as observed without labelling the content-size category.
resume_procedure: The device owner reports the current Settings → Display & Brightness → Text Size position and whether Accessibility Larger Text is enabled.
Record the resulting category only if iOS or an approved inspection tool exposes its canonical name; otherwise retain the observed geometry without inference.
blocks_final_rows: Any later row claiming Dynamic Type behavior

inherited_access_blockers.field: Nihongo accessibility hierarchy
inherited_access_blockers.completed_independent_work: iPhone Mirroring and Xcode Accessibility Inspector were both attempted against the pinned runtime; only the mirroring shell tree was returned.
inherited_access_blockers.fallback: Use a device-owner-assisted VoiceOver traversal and keep screenshots classified as visual rather than semantic evidence.
resume_procedure: Retry Accessibility Inspector with Nihongo foregrounded and iPhone Mirroring disconnected.
If elements remain unavailable, traverse each approved Search surface with VoiceOver and record labels, traits, focus order, actions, and transitions using synthetic content.
Keep each accessibility row blocked until that environment-bound evidence exists.

inherited_access_blockers.field: individual removal of a session-created recent-search row
inherited_access_blockers.completed_independent_work: A known session-created もんだい row was rerun without inspecting older history. Clear All was ruled out because it would delete pre-existing data.
inherited_access_blockers.fallback: Retain the exact row-removal action as untested; do not infer swipe affordance or persistence.
resume_procedure: Create or identify the current top session-created Search row without opening any older row.
At action time, obtain confirmation to permanently remove that one disposable row.
Swipe only that row, record the exposed control and settled result without retaining older history, and verify the query no longer reruns from that row.

inherited_access_blockers.field: standard iOS software-keyboard appearance and dismissal
affected_records: future keyboard visual and accessibility rows
inherited_access_blockers.completed_independent_work: Focus, Cancel, clear, hardware-key input, handwriting, radical, and input-mode accessory behavior were captured. Selecting keyboard mode hid the custom panel but did not expose a software keyboard in the mirrored runtime.
inherited_access_blockers.fallback: Treat typed-input behavior as observed but keep software-keyboard geometry, keys, input source, and dismissal unknown.
resume_procedure: Disconnect any external keyboard path from iPhone Mirroring or use the physical iPhone with the software keyboard forced visible.
With only a synthetic query visible, capture appearance, input-source switching, dismissal, Return/Search, and focus restoration.
Use a privacy crop if recent history is visible above the keyboard.
blocks_final_rows: Future standard software-keyboard visual and interaction rows

inherited_access_blockers.field: long Search-result list scrolling and terminal extent
inherited_access_blockers.owner: device owner or discovery driver with a working physical swipe authority
inherited_access_blockers.completed_independent_work: Long result classes were captured at the top, and visible rows were inventoried. The available scroll command did not move the mirrored list; a coordinate attempt activated an Additional Match and proved its Word Detail edge instead.
inherited_access_blockers.fallback: Do not claim terminal-row, pagination, lazy-load, or scroll-restoration behavior.
resume_procedure: Open the synthetic もんだい or think result set on the physical iPhone.
Swipe the results list to its terminal extent without selecting a row, capturing each newly revealed layout or control.
Return from one newly revealed result, record scroll-position restoration, and repeat until no new rows or controls appear.

inherited_access_blockers.field: Search offline, failure, and retry states
inherited_access_blockers.completed_independent_work: A deterministic no-match state and all required online fixture classes were captured. No distinct loading state persisted long enough to capture.
inherited_access_blockers.fallback: Keep offline, transport failure, stale data, and retry behavior unknown; do not equate the blank no-match state with a network error.
resume_procedure: Confirm a network-isolation method that will not strand iPhone Mirroring, or perform the probe directly on the physical iPhone.
Record the connected starting state, run one cached-looking and one uncached synthetic query, isolate network access, and repeat them.
Capture immediate and settled states, any error copy or retry control, restoration after reconnect, and whether earlier results persist.
Restore the recorded network state before ending the session.

inherited_access_blockers.field: audible word and sentence pronunciation behavior
inherited_access_blockers.owner: device owner with a synchronized audio-capable recorder
inherited_access_blockers.completed_independent_work: Visible word and sentence speaker controls were exercised. No persistent visible playback state was established, so audible content, voice, timing, overlap, interruption, completion, and replay remain unknown.
inherited_access_blockers.fallback: Keep audio claims blocked; a static speaker icon is not evidence of sound content or playback behavior.
resume_procedure: Attach an authorized local audio recorder that captures iPhone Mirroring or physical-device output without uploading content.
Use public fixtures いる, 問題, and 蝶々 and record the settled state before each action.
Capture word and sentence playback start, duration, completion, repeated taps, overlap, interruption by navigation/backgrounding, and recovery.
Hash the trace and retain only privacy-safe derived observations in the dossier.

inherited_access_blockers.field: entries with absent, unavailable, or disabled word/sentence audio
inherited_access_blockers.completed_independent_work: Available-looking controls were observed across common, uncommon, verb, noun, and adjective fixtures.
inherited_access_blockers.fallback: Do not claim that audio is universally available or infer disabled-state appearance.
resume_procedure: Search deliberately rare public entries and example sets until an absent or disabled word and sentence audio class is found or a documented denominator proves none exists.
Capture the full settled state and attempt the control where present.
Record separate unavailable-word and unavailable-sentence classes.

inherited_access_blockers.field: note editor software-keyboard appearance and dismissal
inherited_access_blockers.completed_independent_work: Empty and populated focus states, external-key input, Done, Back auto-save, persistence, deletion, and restoration were captured.
inherited_access_blockers.fallback: Keep keyboard geometry, input-source controls, Return behavior, and dismissal unknown.
resume_procedure: Force the software keyboard visible on the physical iPhone without exposing private history.
Open Add Note on a public fixture and capture empty, typing, multiline, dismissal, refocus, and Done states.
Delete the synthetic note and verify restoration.
blocks_final_rows: Note software-keyboard visual and interaction rows

inherited_access_blockers.completed_independent_work: Back controls, scrolling, taps, and nested navigation cycles were captured. A controller drag did not produce a verified swipe-back transition, and no duration-controlled long press was available.
inherited_access_blockers.fallback: Do not infer gesture behavior from standard iOS conventions.

Test edge-swipe back from Example Sentences, nested Word Detail, and Conjugations, including canceling mid-gesture.
Long-press linked tokens, related rows, meaning text, and speaker controls; record any menu or no-op disposition.

inherited_access_blockers.field: word/detail, examples, conjugations, notes, and audio offline/failure/retry behavior
inherited_access_blockers.completed_independent_work: All retained fixtures were observed in the normal connected state. No distinct loading, error, retry, or stale state was claimed.
inherited_access_blockers.fallback: Do not equate locally available dictionary content with proven offline behavior.
resume_procedure: Confirm a network-isolation method that will not strand iPhone Mirroring, or perform the probe directly on the physical iPhone.
Open cached-looking and previously unopened public word/example fixtures, isolate network access, and repeat navigation, conjugation, note, and audio actions.
Capture immediate and settled states, errors, retries, stale content, and recovery after reconnect.
Restore the recorded network state.

inherited_access_blockers.field: recorded-pronunciation versus speech-synthesis selection and fallback

Choose public entries known or suspected to have a human recording plus deliberately rare entries and examples likely to require fallback.
Record control state, audible output, voice consistency, timing, repeated taps, interruption, backgrounding, cache behavior, and offline behavior.
Crosswalk a clip to a named public source only when stable metadata or an authorized hash proves identity; otherwise retain source as unknown.

Add one-property handwriting contrasts for partial, reversed-order, extra-stroke, kana, and non-jōyō input, plus zero-result and large-set radical contrasts.
Record output/order deltas, run count, screenshots or synchronized traces, network state, and exact restoration between runs.
